situations.headline: SDR Drone (SDCO) discloses non-reliance on prior financial statements

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: SDR Drone (SDCO) discloses non-reliance on prior financial statements (interest 5, risk 8)

thesis.text: SDCO's Item 4.02 non-reliance disclosure is a red flag typical of small-cap/former-shell issuers (ex-Hallmark Venture Group) and warrants close monitoring of the follow-up 8-K/A or amended financials for scope of restatement, auditor involvement, and any control-weakness admissions before taking a position either way.
